question: Which staff are eligible for a messages designation and which for a cases designation, is the eligibility rule the same for both scopes, and is the end of a lapsed designation recorded as an audited decision of a person or as a system event?
decision: Cases designation: case-assignee eligibility. Messages designation: conversation-assignee roles. Expiry is a system event written to the audit log at the moment of expiry (scheduled), not inside the next grant.
originalProposedDecision: Cases designation: case-assignee eligibility. Messages designation: conversation-assignee roles. Expiry is a system event written to the audit log at the moment of expiry (scheduled), not inside the next grant.
